name: @red-cup-engineering/redeem-authorization-code-service
description: Turn an authorization code, its PKCE verifier, and the pending auth-code record it names into a minted bearer token record. Use it at the POST /oauth/token resource for the authorization_code grant; the same token-minting primitive it exposes (mintBearerTokenRecord) is also the right thing to reuse for refresh_token rotation, which mints tokens the same way without redeeming a code.
